authorization: Owner Go: integrate pretrained inference, reproduce references, validate fixed-observation command parity, then bounded Rapier recovery. No migration, training, paid compute, merge or deployment.
hypothesis: The pinned WEAK actor can produce a usable get-up reference in an exact-state Rapier branch and the pinned SLOW actor can follow its source spline in the real body. One fixed candidate; no hand-designed recovery phases.
trigger: Actual impact requested at 2 s. Teacher starts only after measured landed/settled state and apparatus retraction; baseline source standing PD remains unchanged before that.
referenceContract: Clone all native mechanical state. WEAK 40 Hz/200 Hz, at most 250 decisions, head >1.4 m then one further decision as source. Abort on integrity failure or absent teacher terminal. Interpolate 25-component targets with source not-a-knot cubic at speed .5, append exact source standing target. SLOW 40 Hz with 800 Hz clipped PD. No reference state is assigned to the real body.
standingCriterion: New GetUp geometry: head >1.4 m (source terminal); torso up >=.97; both feet load >=3 N for .05 s; feet carry >=80% body weight; no other body load >=3 N; CoM and capture inside actual solver contact hull with 3 mm margin; all body speeds <=.22 m/s and <=.65 rad/s; feet drift <=1 cm throughout one continuous second; completed <=25 s after measured impact. Prototype only, not 24-case qualification.
stop: First native integrity failure, reference refusal, missing diagnostics/continuity, stable-standing proof, 25 s after impact, 28 s total real time, 23650 total native integrations, or 900 wall seconds. No retry, parameter variant, or budget renewal.
